lines: Drop sea friends in the tank. Two of the same touch and they merge into the next one up.
Sand dollar → moon snail → scallop → starfish → crab… all the way up to a dolphin 🐬
Two dolphins swim off together for a 100 point bonus.
The only rule: don't let the stack stay above the dotted line.
It starts calm. Then the tank fills up 😅
A relaxing merge puzzle drawn in pencil.
comments: Has anyone made two dolphins yet? 🐬🐬 {url}
Which sea friend is your favourite? {url}
The tank was SO close to overflowing 😬 {url}

lines: Drop numbered balls in the jar. Two of the same touch and they merge into double.
Gravity does the rest, and merges can set off chain reactions.
Keep the pile below the dashed danger line.
Bigger merges are worth way more points.
comments: What's the biggest ball you've made? {url}

lines: Hold to grab a push-pin with your rope, let go to fling forward.
A caped kid swinging over a pencil city 🦸
Grab stars for bonus points on the way.
Balloons bob up and down, and soap bubbles pop soon after you grab them.
The farther you go, the farther apart the pins get.
comments: That last pin was SO far 😅 {url}

lines: Guess the secret word in six tries ✏️
Green means right spot, yellow means wrong spot, grey means not in the word.
Solve words in a row for a streak bonus.
Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced.
comments: Did you guess it before I did? 👀 {url}
How many tries did it take you? {url}

lines: Steer a hungry little whirlpool and gulp anything smaller than you 🌀
Every gulp makes you a little bigger.
Fill the size meter before the timer runs out.
Too big? Come back when you've grown.
comments: What's the biggest thing you've gulped? 🌀 {url}

lines: Hop Milo across busy streets full of cars, bikes, scooters and skateboards.
Cross the creek on surfboards, rafts and tubes.
Keep moving, a rainstorm is creeping up behind you ☔
Wait for a gap… then hop!
comments: That skateboard came out of nowhere 😂 {url}

lines: Slide each block out through the gate that matches its colour.
Blocks can't overlap, so plan your moves.
A block only fits a gate that's at least as wide as it is.
Clear the board before the timer runs out.
comments: Which block would you move first? 👇 {url}
So satisfying when it slides out 😌 {url}

lines: Drop a stack and same-colour neighbours hop together.
Get 10 of one colour on top and they pop.
One pop can set off another for combo points.
Don't let the board fill up.
comments: Where would you drop the next stack? 👇 {url}

lines: Swipe to slice the fruit as it splashes up 🍉
Slice two or more in one swipe for a combo bonus.
Steer clear of the spiky sea urchins.
Every 500 points wins a lost life back.
Find the hidden words in a hand-drawn letter board 🔎
Every level has a theme and its own word list.
Later words hide on a slant and even backwards.
Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced.
comments: Can you find the last word before I do? 👀 {url}
Word search fans, how did I do? {url}
Which word took you the longest? 👇 {url}

lines: Pull back like a slingshot, aim and putt ⛳
Watch out for sand, slopes, the tide and water.
A hole in one is worth 1000 points.
Mini golf, drawn in a sketchbook.
Link words around the path and turn all twelve letters gold ✨
Each next letter has to come from a different side.
Your next word starts with the last letter of the one before.
Try to solve it in the par number of words.
Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced.
comments: How many words did it take you? 👇 {url}

lines: Race a twisting sketchbook path through downtown, the backyard, the park, the creek and the woods.
Swipe to turn at every corner, jump over logs and slide under branches.
Your runner gets faster the longer you last 😅
An endless runner drawn entirely in pencil ✏️
comments: That corner came out of nowhere 😂 {url}
Downtown, park or woods: which is your favourite? 👇 {url}

lines: Spin a giant pencil and drop a bouncy striped ball through the rings.
Don't land on the pink scribbles or the sliding ink blots.
Fall through three rings without bouncing to smash the next one.
Land in the pencil cup to clear the level.
Pull thumbtacks out of popsicle sticks and sort them into paper cups 📌
Three tacks of the same colour fill a cup.
Pull a stick's last tack and it plunks onto the desk.
Don't let the pencil case fill up.
comments: Which tack would you pull first? 👇 {url}

lines: Grab gold stars and race them back to your fort ⭐
Only banked stars count, so don't get splatted on the way.
Pick Max, Ruby or Leo and brawl against three computer rivals.
Dodge the sprinklers!
comments: How many stars did you bank? {url}

lines: Tap at just the right moment to hit the target 🎯
Bullseyes in a row build a combo worth more and more.
You get three darts. Never hit the pufferfish.
Smash the bonus sand dollars when they pop up.
comments: How many bullseyes in a row can you get? 🎯 {url}

lines: Drag across the letter wheel to spell words and fill the crossword ✏️
Extra real words count as bonus words.
Find words fast to build a combo up to 5X.
Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced.
comments: How many words can you find? 👇 {url}
Did you spot the long one? 👀 {url}

lines: Drag to aim. The line shows exactly where your shot will bounce.
Pop a group and everything hanging below falls off for bonus points.
Bank shots off the wall are the best part 👀
Clear the board before the bubbles cross the line.
comments: Did you see that bank shot? 👀 {url}
How many bubbles did that one shot drop? 👇 {url}

lines: Sixteen words. Find the four secret groups of four.
Groups start easy, then get sneaky.
Some words seem to fit two groups at once 👀
Yellow is the easiest group. Pink is the trickiest.
comments: Did you spot the pink group? 👀 {url}
How many tries did it take you? {url}

lines: Tap doodle tiles off the pile and collect three of a kind ✏️
Don't let your 7-spot tray fill up.
Clear the tiles on top to free the ones underneath.
Each level stacks the pile higher.
comments: Which tile would you tap next? 👇 {url}

lines: Tap a pencil to send it sliding off the notepad ✏️
It only makes it if nothing is in its way.
Every pencil that leaves opens a path for the others.
Clear the whole page to finish the level.
comments: Which pencil would you tap first? 👇 {url}
So satisfying when the last one goes 😌 {url}

lines: Drop letter bubbles. Matching colours unscramble into a hidden word.
Two of the same letter merge into silver, then gold.
Swipe across bubbles to spell the hidden words.
A merge game and a word game in one.
comments: Did you spot the word before I did? 👀 {url}
Word nerds, how did I do? 👇 {url}

lines: Fly a little rocket and blast the UFOs 🚀
Some saucers are tiny. The mothership takes a few hits.
Dodge the swooping ships and their alien goo.
Every third level is a bonus parade.
comments: That goo came out of nowhere 😤 {url}
How many rockets did you have left? 👇 {url}

lines: Every gem starts in the wrong spot. Put them all back 💎
Pick up touching gems of the same colour all at once.
Stash gems in the tray until you find their spot.
Zoom in and watch the chibi animal rebuild itself.
Pick a colour and fill every numbered square 🎨
Rockets, planets and UFOs on grid paper 🪐

comments: Which picture should I do next? 👇 {url}
Who else finds this weirdly calming? {url}

lines: Drag shapes onto the graph paper and clear rows and columns.
Place all three pieces to get three new ones.

comments: Where would you put the next piece? 👇 {url}

lines: Link matching classroom icons with a path of no more than two turns.
Touched icons light up in coloured pencil ✏️

Clear the whole board before time runs out.
comments: Can you spot the next pair? 👀 {url}
How fast did you clear it? 👇 {url}

lines: Swap two school supplies to line up three or more.
